parameters.content:
# Target selection (use cases covered)
## Single target
- attack a player
- attack an iron golem or other mob
- attack an animal
- if target location is unspecified, teleport workers to leader location (must get coordinates of the leader)


## Multiple targets
-  leader <leader name> workers


## Workers (warriors)
- teleport-workers teleports all workers in the session to target locatiok

combatPlan.combatRequest: Attack Pippo's workers with all available workers.
combatPlan.tacticalsummary: All available soldiers engage in coordinated attack on Pippo's workers, distributing focus across multiple targets.

battlefieldAssessment.recommendations: Maintain visual contact with your squad to ensure effective coordination.

soldierInstructions.objective: Engage Pippo's worker immediately, focusing all attacks on this target.

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point

constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of your target
Maintain at least 3 blocks distance from other soldiers
If target destroyed or flees, acquire next available target
Abort if no targets found after 60 seconds
soldierInstructions.instructionText: You are the tank. Equip your best sword or axe. Search for any of Pippo's workers within 30 blocks. Once found, approach from the front and attack immediately. Keep attacking for up to 60 seconds. If your health drops below 7 hearts (14 HP), retreat immediately.

soldierInstructions.objective: Find and engage a separate worker from Pippo's team.

healthManagement.action: disengage immediately and move to rally point

constraints: Stay within 30 blocks of your target
Maintain at least 3 blocks distance from other soldiers
If target destroyed or flees, acquire next available target
Abort if no targets found after 60 seconds
soldierInstructions.instructionText: You are the flanker. Wait 1.5 seconds, then equip your best sword or axe. Search for any of Pippo's workers within 30 blocks. Once found, approach from the rear and attack. Keep attacking for up to 60 seconds. If your health drops below 7 hearts (14 HP), retreat immediately.

combatPlan.victoryCondition: All targeted workers are defeated or forced to retreat.
combatPlan.failureCondition: If soldiers cannot locate targets within 60 seconds or are forced to retreat due to low health.
combatPlan.safetyNotes: Prioritize survival and retreat if health is critically low.
